video_title: D'Angelo Russell talks NBA Free Agency

quotes.speaker: Link
quotes.summary_phrase: 76ers roster strength compared to Warriors team
quotes.excerpt: on paper they're the best team ever assembled, even better than what his Warriors team is

text_blocks.speaker: Link
text_blocks.text: I want to know what your thoughts are with the 76ers. They get Jaylen Brown, the 76ers are obviously on paper a really good team, but Kevin Durant is saying that on paper they're the best team ever assembled, even better than what his Warriors team is. I don't know how I feel about that.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
text_blocks.text: You have to respect somebody of Kevin Durant's caliber to put things in that way. I think you have to respect that and take it into consideration. I haven't thought much about it, so I don't know as far as comparing it to the Warriors, but I do know they're championship or bust, right? That team. But also adding a guy like LeBron James to a team that did really well last year without a guy like Joel Embiid, and then you add a healthy Joel Embiid, I think that is debatable.

quotes.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant's underrated status in Portland
quotes.excerpt: under-rated Ja Morant in Portland. Everybody is going big, everybody is deciding to go to prepare for Wembanyama
quotes.quote: My biggest talk is underrated Ja Morant in Portland. Everybody is going big, everybody is deciding to go to prepare for Victor Wembanyama, prepare for Nikola Jokic, etc. But also the teams that are going team-oriented, they're taking that advantage that way. But then there's going to be teams that I think are going to be heavy on the guards, smaller guards too, not big Cade Cunningham vibes, but you have Damian Lillard, Ja Morant, Scoot Henderson with a chip on his shoulder. I think Drew Holiday is still there. Mark my words, I think Portland is going to be underrated.

quotes.speaker: Link
quotes.summary_phrase: Utah Jazz's potential as a young team
quotes.excerpt: I don't think Utah is going to come out and be championship contenders by any means

text_blocks.speaker: Link
text_blocks.text: Under-rated, I think under-rated my West is Utah. I don't think Utah is going to come out and be championship contenders by any means, but I think they're young and I like what they're building over there. So I think they're going to be more of the flirting with that potentially making a playoff spot.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
text_blocks.text: Jaren Grant is going to take that KG level to where he's like KG with the Boston. He brought that energy and that dog that he obviously established himself in Memphis with. I think he's going to bring that to Utah too, so I do like Utah, and I like their coach a lot.

quotes.speaker: Link
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball's move to the Timberwolves
quotes.excerpt: I'm excited to see that because I know how Anthony Edwards is as a human being

text_blocks.speaker: Link
text_blocks.text: I'll tell you who I'm most excited to watch play basketball. Last year for me, my favorite team to watch was the Hornets. I loved how they played basketball. And so with LaMelo Ball going to the Timberwolves, I'm excited to see that because I know how Anthony Edwards is as a human being and LaMelo Ball going there, I'm sure that's going to be some fun basketball to watch.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
text_blocks.text: A lot of people aren't sold on it. Inside sources Kevin Harrington said that he doesn't like LaMelo Ball in Minnesota. He doesn't think it's going to work. And I think it is. I think him, seeing him in a situation where he's kind of dependent on to play winning basketball, I think Finch is going to bring that out of him.

quotes.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: Atlanta Hawks as an underrated team
quotes.excerpt: I think the Hawks are going to be underrated, dude. Like they're going to be a team
quotes.quote: I will say I think the Hawks are going to be underrated, dude. Like they're going to be a team that nobody's really going to want to see. Coming into Atlanta is going to be jumping, but then also when they travel, I think they're going to be a hard team. They might have a, they might surprise people with their wins on the road. I'm going to call that, Atlanta on the road.

quotes.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: Giannis Antetokounmpo's move to the Heat
quotes.excerpt: I think that they're going to be that team that they're modern day Memphis Grizzlies
quotes.quote: I like it. I was just saying I think that they're going to be that team that they're modern day Memphis Grizzlies when when Mike Conley was in Memphis, Tony Allen, Marc Gasol, Zach Randolph, those guys, dogs, Jae Crowder. When they had all those dudes in Memphis, you knew when you went to Memphis, it was going to be a dog fight. The score might be 88 to 95 and it's just going to be a dog fight. A few guys are going to foul out. That timeout's going to come down to a crucial one. All that little stuff that you used to see, I think you're going to see more of that when it comes to to Miami. They're going to be able to score, but the way they're going to play their style is going to be really beat you down, wear you out type of style.

quotes.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen Curry's potential move to the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: I would love to see Stephen Curry go to Boston. Boston? Yeah, I would love to see that
quotes.quote: I would love to see Stephen Curry go to Boston. Boston? Yeah, I would love to see that. Just because I think he needs that type of help around him now. Like who who's taking the load off him in Golden State? The rookie? Is Jimmy? Oh yeah, healthy Jimmy. I think you have a veteran team that's going to know how to win the last three minutes of a game. They're going to know how to win. I just, just getting to the last three minutes is where they're going to struggle.

quotes.speaker: Link
quotes.excerpt: I think that selfishly I also would want Stephen Curry to go somewhere else

text_blocks.speaker: Link
text_blocks.text: I'm torn on Stephen Curry going somewhere else because one, he has his legacy in Golden State and I love the fact that he's won there in a plethora of different ways, one of the MVPs, all that. So if he retired a Warrior and that's how he went out, great. But I think that selfishly I also would want Stephen Curry to go somewhere else because I still believe he is one of, if not the most plug-and-play player you could put on any team and he would just fit.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
text_blocks.text: Or you'll see where like system is huge. The only time you really get to see Stephen Curry outside of that system is USA basketball. Right. And he went crazy. Among those players. He did struggle for Stephen Curry the first few games. That's an adjustment that I think he hasn't had. He hasn't had to see that. He's so used to passing the ball and everybody sacrificing themselves to get him open and get the ball back.

quotes.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: Clippers' youth movement and Brandon Ingram
quotes.excerpt: I do like the Clippers too. Like I like the Clippers taking that route of like
quotes.quote: I do like the Clippers too. Like I like the Clippers taking that route of like we're going to go a little younger. We're going to start establishing ourselves in the youth. They got some rookies that are dogs. And then they got and then I like um and then Brandon Ingram if that trade goes through, I like Brandon Ingram there under Tyronn Lue. Got Rui Hachimura too. Rui Hachi Hachi Tachi. Shout out Rui. Got to stay in the crib. Shout out to Chef Ali.

quotes.speaker: Link
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum's team and Jaylen Brown
quotes.excerpt: I'm excited to see Jayson Tatum being able to like it's his team, solidified his team

text_blocks.speaker: Link
text_blocks.text: I'm excited to see Jayson Tatum being able to like it's his team, solidified his team. I know before there's people that said it was his team versus Jaylen Brown's team, but now it's just like it's yours.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
text_blocks.text: He caught him Jason like he got his money on speed dial.

quotes.speaker: Link
quotes.excerpt: Jaylen Brown's going to another situation where he's he may still be the guy

text_blocks.speaker: Link
text_blocks.text: I can't really say the same for Jaylen Brown because I think Jaylen Brown's going to another situation where he's he may still be the guy. I don't know how that dynamic is going to be, but he's going to have to play a little probably a little bit different style of basketball than I think Jayson Tatum's going to be able to.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
text_blocks.text: To see all, bro, Philly, to see all those dudes just in attack mode, which is already the style they played in like they're going to be tough to beat, tough to beat.

quotes.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
quotes.summary_phrase: Phoenix Suns as a sleeper team
quotes.excerpt: A team that nobody is going to be mentioning and it's up to them to bring that light
quotes.quote: I think the a team that nobody is going to be mentioning and it's up to them to bring that light is Phoenix. Like nobody's talking about Phoenix, nobody's mentioning them, nobody is going to think that they're a team that's going to make any noise. I'm telling you that coach over there is is elite. Jordan is elite. And then you add healthy Jaylen Green, Miles Bridges, Dylan Brooks, Book. Their bigs, I'm like, you got the Ryan Dunns that's gotten better, you know, Gillespie's more comfortable. Like it's all team-oriented now.

quotes.speaker: Link
quotes.excerpt: I think the Thunder they're going to run it back without Lou Dort

text_blocks.speaker: Link
text_blocks.text: I think the Thunder they're going to run it back without Lou Dort.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
text_blocks.text: Okay, that was that is for sure what I also think. I think that they're my early favorite without seeing anybody else play. I think they're coming back with a chip on their shoulder. Hopefully everybody's healthy and they're ready to rock.

quotes.speaker: Link
quotes.excerpt: apparently he signed for or they stayed and it was 185, but then he took 180

text_blocks.speaker: Link
text_blocks.text: I didn't ask him about this because I didn't know, but apparently he signed for or they stayed and it was 185, but then he took 180 so they could have 5 million to get or do something else with.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
text_blocks.text: Good for him, man. Shout out to Austin, one of our alumni at Backyard Cup. Should we go to Backyard Cup?

quotes.speaker: Link
quotes.excerpt: there's no way he might be have played golf for a year

text_blocks.speaker: Link
text_blocks.text: I also, so this is this is one thing that I would love to talk about is there's no way he might be have played golf for a year. Like on the course, playing golf, taking it a little bit more seriously, but I don't buy the only playing for a year. His swing's too good. Like it's too pure.

text_blocks.speaker: D'Angelo Russell
text_blocks.text: I think he definitely was just like I didn't even ask him how many lessons he's gotten, but he definitely was hammering lessons at some point in his life where that should just came to the light and he had the internet in shambles when he was like I just started, this and that and I ain't saying he lying, it's just the way it's just so
